title: Golf Net 305x305 cm – Practice Net for the Garden
descriptionHtml:
Practice your golf swing at home in the yard

Practicing golf usually means a trip to the range. It takes time and makes it easy to skip the small sessions.

A big net that catches the balls

This golf net is 305x305 cm and catches the balls securely. It's sturdily built and withstands hard hits – so you can practice your swing whenever you like in the backyard.

Features

  • Large hitting area of 305x305 cm
  • Sturdy net that withstands hard hits
  • Catches the balls securely
  • Easy to set up in the yard
  • Good for swing and short-game practice

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
